title: Filter countries by exact name length
description: Write a function `filter_exact_length(countries, n)` that returns the countries whose name is exactly `n` characters long, using `filter()`.
hints: Function to consider: filter(), combined with len()
len(c) == n is the per-item condition - filter() keeps every country where that comparison is True.
Return list(filter(lambda c: len(c) == n, countries)).
expected_behavior: Returns the countries whose name has exactly n characters.
solution:
def filter_exact_length(countries, n):
    return list(filter(lambda c: len(c) == n, countries))
explanation: Swapping the lambda's condition is all that separates this from filter_containing - filter() itself doesn't change, only what question its callback asks.
